preview_text: Vinicius Junior carried Brazil through the group stage with four goals in three matches, including a brace against Scotland as Brazil closed out with a 3-0 win to top Group C.

Matheus Cunha recorded three goals across the group stage and has formed a dynamic attacking partnership with Vinicius Junior. Bruno Guimaraes supplied the most assists of any Brazilian player in the group stage.

Brazil posted a 3-0 victory over Scotland in their final group game, with Vinicius Junior adding two more goals and Matheus Cunha completing the scoring. The Selecao finished as the top team in Group C with seven points.

Vinicius Junior leads Brazil in DFS value as the tournament top scorer, while Douglas Santos provides a budget stacking option at left back with overlapping runs into attack. Matheus Cunha offers upside at a mid-tier price with three group stage goals and corner kick involvement.

Japan advanced from Group F in second place after a 1-1 draw with Sweden in their final match. Japan took the lead in the 56th minute through a well-worked team move finished close range, before Sweden equalized six minutes later. Zion Suzuki made crucial late saves to preserve the draw and knockout qualification.

Junya Ito served as Japan corner kick taker throughout the group stage. Zion Suzuki made a crucial diving save to deny Alexander Isak late in the Sweden match, helping Japan hold on for the draw and knockout qualification.
Japan scored seven goals in the group stage, the most by any Japanese side at a single World Cup. Ayase Ueda and Daichi Kamada finished as joint leading scorers with two goals each.
Junya Ito offers corner kick exposure and attacking output as a creative winger, while Daichi Kamada and Ayase Ueda provide goal upside from Japan attacking positions.

Germany topped Group E with seven points after wins over Curaçao and Ivory Coast. A late substitute secured a 2-1 comeback win over Ivory Coast with two second-half goals, the second coming in stoppage time. The Musiala-Wirtz-Havertz attacking triangle averaged over 2.0 expected goals per game in the group stage.

Joshua Kimmich served as Germany corner kick taker and right back, while Nathaniel Brown operated at left back and carries a minor groin concern entering the knockout round. The Musiala-Wirtz-Havertz attacking triangle averaged over 2.0 expected goals per game in the group stage.

Germany finished the group stage with 10 goals from seven different scorers. They were the joint-highest side in shots on target per match. The final group game was a rotated loss to Ecuador, a dead rubber after they had already qualified.

Jamal Musiala and Florian Wirtz are the top DFS targets from Germany as the creative fulcrum of Nagelsmann's attack. Joshua Kimmich provides corner kick volume from right back at a salary that undervalues his total contribution.

Paraguay qualified for the Round of 32 as a third-place wildcard with four points. Their only win came in Round 2 against Turkey, when Matias Galarza scored in the second minute from a Julio Enciso assist to secure a 1-0 result.
Julio Enciso assisted both of Paraguay's group stage goals and served as primary corner kick taker. Diego Gomez is suspended for this match after a red card earlier in the tournament.

Paraguay held consecutive clean sheets in their final two group games after conceding four against the United States in Round 1. Miguel Almiron returns from suspension after missing the Australia draw.

Julio Enciso is the key DFS pivot for Paraguay as the only proven creator in their lineup and corner taker, while Orlando Gill in goal offers budget value with clean sheet upside against a German side that rotated heavily in Round 3.

Netherlands topped Group F with seven points, including a 3-1 win over Tunisia in their final group match. Brian Brobbey scored in the 7th minute after Virgil van Dijk headed on a Tijjani Reijnders free kick, his third goal of the tournament.

Tijjani Reijnders served as corner and free kick delivery source in the Tunisia match, with his corner in the 62nd minute leading directly to Jan Paul van Hecke's header that restored the two-goal lead. Denzel Dumfries provided the cross that led to the opening own goal.
Netherlands scored five goals against Sweden in Round 2 and three more against Tunisia in Round 3. Gakpo, Brobbey, and Malen have all contributed in the group stage as part of a deep attacking group.

Brian Brobbey offers forward upside at a salary below the Gakpo-Malen tier after scoring three goals in the group stage. Tijjani Reijnders drives corner kick volume as a central midfielder with direct delivery, while Denzel Dumfries provides attacking width at right back with consistent involvement in build-up play.

Morocco qualified from Group C in second place after defeating Haiti 4-2 in Round 3. Achraf Hakimi scored in the 39th minute and then crossed for Ismael Saibari to equalize before halftime. Saibari's goal was his third of the group stage.

Achraf Hakimi served as Morocco's corner kick taker throughout the group stage and converted the decisive assist in the Haiti match. Ismael Saibari scored in each of Morocco's three group matches as the most consistent scorer in the Atlas Lions squad.

Morocco scored four goals against Haiti from a 2-1 second-half deficit, with Soufiane Rahimi and Gessime Yassine completing the comeback as substitutes. Brahim Diaz nearly added a halftime goal when his curling effort struck the post.

Achraf Hakimi is the highest-opto player on the full slate with corner kick volume and direct attacking output, making him the GPP cornerstone from Morocco. Ismael Saibari offers three goals of momentum entering the Round of 32.
